articles.headline: Sharvari Wagh Calls Marriage the End Goal of Love Ahead of Her Bridal Debut in Yeh Prem Mol Liya
articles.dek: Actor Sharvari Wagh opens up about her traditional upbringing, her perspective on relationships, and experiencing her first on-screen bridal look in the upcoming film Yeh Prem Mol Liya.

p: Actor Sharvari Wagh is gearing up for her first-ever on-screen bridal appearance in the upcoming romantic drama Yeh Prem Mol Liya. Directed by filmmaker Sooraj Barjatya, the movie features Sharvari alongside Ayushmann Khurrana in the lead roles.
The project has generated considerable interest among fans of Bollywood family dramas, especially with its scheduled release date of November 27.

body.h: Sharvari Wagh on Love and Marriage
p: In a recent interaction with India Today, Sharvari discussed her personal philosophy regarding romance and long-term commitments. Having grown up in a traditional household, she explained that her perspective on relationships is deeply rooted in heritage and family values.
According to the actor, she firmly believes that marriage serves as the ultimate conclusion to a committed partnership. For her, falling in love naturally leads to the milestone of tying the knot.

body.h: A Family Wedding and an Emotional Mother
p: Taking on a bridal role for the first time proved to be a deeply emotional experience for Sharvari's real-life family. The filming schedule coincided with her older sister's actual wedding, creating a unique atmosphere of celebration both on and off the set.

When Sharvari's mother saw her dressed as a bride on screen, the visuals overwhelmed her with emotion. Having recently watched one daughter leave home after marriage, seeing Sharvari in bridal attire brought her to tears.

Sharvari expressed deep appreciation for director Sooraj Barjatya and the way he presents his female characters. She noted that seeing herself transformed into such a stunning cinematic bride was a memorable highlight of her career.
The actor praised the filmmaker's signature aesthetic, which often highlights traditional values and grand familial celebrations within Indian cinema.

Alongside lead actors Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari Wagh, Yeh Prem Mol Liya boasts an ensemble cast of celebrated performers. Veteran actors Anupam Kher, Supriya Pathak, Seema Pahwa, and Saumya Tandon play pivotal roles in the narrative.
Helmed by Sooraj R. Barjatya, the film is positioned as a major theatrical release blending emotional storytelling with traditional family dynamics.

With its premiere locked for November 27, audiences are eager to see the fresh on-screen pairing of Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari Wagh. The combination of Barjatya's directorial style and a star-studded supporting cast has kept anticipation high.
The project marks a significant step in Sharvari's career as she explores a traditional romantic space under the guidance of one of Bollywood's most renowned directors.

Actor Sharvari Wagh shared her traditional views on love and marriage ahead of her first on-screen bridal debut in the film Yeh Prem Mol Liya, directed by Sooraj Barjatya. She revealed that filming coincided with her older sister's wedding, which made seeing her bridal look particularly emotional for her mother. The movie, starring Sharvari and Ayushmann Khurrana alongside Anupam Kher, Supriya Pathak, Seema Pahwa, and Saumya Tandon, is set to release on November 27.

articles.headline: A Heartwarming Exchange: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay Reacts to a Young Admirer's Surprise Kiss
articles.dek: An affectionate moment between Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay and a child at a recognition event in Chennai captured widespread public attention online.

body.h: The Viral Moment at the Chennai Venue
p: A heartwarming and unexpected exchange between Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay and a young child rapidly captured public attention during a public ceremony in Chennai. The incident took place during an ongoing felicitation ceremony held at the RK Convention Centre, located in the Neelankarai area of the city.

As the proceedings unfolded on stage, the young boy approached the politician and delivered an affectionate kiss directly to his cheek. Visibly surprised by the spontaneous gesture, the political leader responded with a gentle, broad smile and exchanged a few brief words with the child before smoothly returning to the scheduled stage events.

body.h: Social Media Reaction and Digital Footprint
p: Footage of the unexpected encounter quickly spread across various digital networks and social media applications, with event attendees and dedicated supporters widely sharing the video clips. The charming interaction instantly became the most talked-about highlight of the entire ceremony.

Online users flooded the comment sections of the shared video with affectionate symbols, including heart and heart-eye emojis. Many admirers posted comments expressing deep appreciation for the warm and approachable demeanor displayed by the Chief Minister during the surprise encounter.

body.h: Background of the TVK Education Awards
p: The memorable interaction occurred against the backdrop of the TVK Education Awards, also referred to as the Kalvi Virudhu initiative. This annual recognition program was established to honor exceptionally high-performing Class 10 and Class 12 public examination students hailing from various regions across Tamil Nadu.

Initially launched in the year 2023, the educational initiative reached its fourth consecutive edition by 2026. The structured outreach program honors deserving merit-holders representing multiple Assembly constituencies by distributing formal certificates of appreciation alongside valuable cash incentives.

body.h: Organizational Nature of the Student Outreach
p: Although C Joseph Vijay assumed the role of state leader following the electoral victory of Thamizhaga Vettri Kazhagam in the 2026 Tamil Nadu Assembly elections, the student-focused awards are managed distinctly. The political organization deliberately maintains the ceremony as an independent, party-run student outreach initiative rather than transitioning it into an official government-operated function.

This continuity allows the leadership to maintain direct, grassroots connections with young scholars and their families through a trusted platform that predates the party's formal ascent to state governance.

body.h: Transition From Cinema to State Leadership
p: The prominent public figure transitioned into full-time governance following a celebrated and extensive career in the South Indian film industry. His final cinematic venture, a Tamil action drama titled Jana Nayagan directed by H Vinoth, marked his sixty-ninth and ultimate leading role before his permanent exit from acting.
The cinematic project was brought to global audiences on July 23, 2026, which occurred roughly two and a half months after he officially took the oath of office as the Chief Minister of the state.

body.h: Legacy of His Final Cinematic Release
p: The theatrical release of Jana Nayagan was backed by KVN Productions and featured an original musical score composed by Anirudh Ravichander. The ensemble cast included notable performers such as Pooja Hegde, Bobby Deol, and Mamitha Baiju.

Despite encountering obstacles prior to its premiere, including censor-related delays and an unauthorized online leak, the film drew massive fan attendance in theaters. It ultimately concluded its theatrical run by securing the position of the highest-grossing Tamil film released throughout 2026.

An unexpected moment occurred when a young boy kissed Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay on the cheek at the TVK Education Awards in Chennai, drawing widespread online praise. The political leader responded with a warm smile during the student felicitation event, which highlights merit-holders across the state. This public appearance follows his transition from his final acting role in the hit Tamil action drama Jana Nayagan to leading the state after the 2026 elections.

articles.headline: Keerthy Suresh Shares Lighthearted Insights About Married Life With Antony Thattil
articles.dek: Popular actress Keerthy Suresh recently opened up about her relationship with husband Antony Thattil, sharing amusing details regarding their shopping habits and kitchen experiences.

p: In a recent candid interview, acclaimed film star Keerthy Suresh offered fans a delightful look into her personal life away from the glittering lights of the entertainment industry. During the conversation, she discussed various lighthearted aspects of her marriage to Antony Thattil, including how their daily habits differ significantly. Among the most amusing tidbits shared was a fun revelation concerning retail therapy and shopping preferences.

When asked directly about who holds the title of the more enthusiastic shopper between the two, Keerthy openly admitted that she takes the crown. She explained that she clearly does a much higher volume of shopping compared to her husband. According to the actress, whenever they visit retail spaces together, Antony patiently waits at a designated spot while she browses, noting that otherwise the entire experience proves quite tedious for him.

Beyond their contrasting retail routines, the conversation also shifted toward domestic chores and culinary preferences within their household. While Keerthy occasionally steps into the kitchen to prepare meals, her husband's culinary skills are practically nonexistent. The actress candidly shared that Antony really does not know how to cook, leaving most kitchen-related duties to other arrangements or her occasional efforts.

These domestic insights showcase a grounded and relatable side to the celebrity couple. Despite their high-profile careers and public standing, their day-to-day life involves the same light-hearted compromises and humorous domestic divisions found in any typical household.

The journey that led Keerthy and Antony to marriage spans well over a decade of deep personal history. Long before walking down the aisle, the couple had known each other for several years. Keerthy revealed that their paths first crossed back in December 2009, which eventually blossomed into a romantic relationship starting in January 2010.

For nearly fifteen years, the pair chose to keep their relationship largely out of the public eye, successfully maintaining privacy despite the intense media scrutiny that often surrounds prominent actors. It was not until November 2024 that Keerthy officially chose to make their long-term relationship public, catching many fans and followers by surprise.

body.h: A Traditional Wedding Celebration in Goa
p: Following the public announcement of their relationship, the couple wasted little time in taking the next big step. Keerthy Suresh and Antony Thattil officially tied the knot on December 12, 2024. The destination wedding took place in the scenic coastal setting of Goa, surrounded strictly by close friends and immediate family members.

The wedding ceremony itself was a heartfelt affair that honored their respective backgrounds. The celebrations thoughtfully incorporated traditional rituals rooted in both of their families' cultural practices, making the milestone event a deeply meaningful union for the newlyweds and their loved ones.

body.h: An Illustrious Acting Career Across Industries
p: While enjoying this new chapter of her personal life, Keerthy continues to maintain a busy and diverse professional schedule. She actively accepts and explores compelling acting roles spanning across multiple major film industries, including Tamil, Telugu, and Malayalam cinema. Her dedication to versatile storytelling has cemented her status as a powerhouse performer.

Among the numerous accolades decorating her career, a major high point remains her prestigious National Film Award for Best Actress. She earned this top honor through her critically acclaimed portrayal of the legendary actress Savitri in the biographical drama film Mahanati.

body.h: Recent Projects and Silver Screen Releases
p: Keerthy's cinematic footprint also extends into Bollywood, where she made her official Hindi film debut starring directly opposite Varun Dhawan in the action thriller Baby John. Her ability to transition seamlessly between regional industries and national cinema highlights her broad acting range.

Adding to her extensive filmography, her latest theatrical release is a courtroom drama titled Sathyavan Savithiri. Directed by Praveen S Vijaay, the film features Keerthy sharing screen space with actor Mysskin and arrived in movie theaters on November 20, 2026.

Actress Keerthy Suresh recently shared amusing insights into her marriage with husband Antony Thattil, revealing that she is the more enthusiastic shopper while he prefers to wait patiently during retail outings and lacks cooking skills. The couple, who first met in December 2009 and began dating in January 2024, kept their relationship private for nearly fifteen years before making it public in November 2024 and marrying in Goa on December 12, 2024. Alongside her personal life, Keerthy continues a successful acting career marked by her National Award-winning role in Mahanati, a Bollywood debut in Baby John, and her latest theatrical release Sathyavan Savithiri.

articles.headline: Unofficial GTA 6 PC Project Revived by 15-Year-Old Lead Developer
articles.dek: Days after announcing his departure due to Discord server takedowns and online friction, the teenager behind the unofficial Grand Theft Auto VI port project confirms it is still active.

p: Grand Theft Auto VI notably debuted strictly on current-generation home consoles, releasing exclusively for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S without a simultaneous computer version. This absence prompted independent fans and community developers to build unofficial computer adaptations.

Among these unauthorized endeavors, a project known as Leonida gained substantial attention online. The undertaking is led by an anonymous individual who identifies as a 15-year-old developer operating under the online pseudonym NotRexed.
The project recently made headlines when its teenage lead abruptly stepped away from the undertaking. This temporary exit followed an apparent Discord platform takedown targeting their server.

The developer cited intense pressure as the primary reason for quitting, noting that balancing academic responsibilities and sports was already challenging enough without dealing with angry individuals complaining on messaging channels.

Despite the brief hiatus, the lead developer has reversed course and confirmed that the unofficial computer adaptation is far from abandoned. A public statement shared on social media explicitly stated that the effort remains ongoing.

The project creator mentioned that considerable development progress has taken place behind the scenes. Additional updates and demonstrations regarding the unofficial port are expected to be shared in the near future.

Alongside the resurrection announcement, the teenager revealed further technical aspirations for the project. Specifically, future iterations of the unofficial port are planned to incorporate native Linux operating system support.

Further details regarding how this compatibility will be achieved are slated for release at a later date. Verifying the actual progress of these claims remains difficult due to the independent and unauthorized nature of the undertaking.

The momentum behind these unofficial computer adaptation efforts largely stemmed from activities by a well-known community figure. A prominent leaker identified as Cyberleek previously circulated an executable file alongside an Xbox build of the game online.
Following this distribution, community members and independent coders seized the shared material to accelerate their own attempts at bringing the blockbuster title to computer systems.
Developer Rockstar Games has not issued any public statements regarding the unofficial port or the community Discord server actions. The studio's official release remains limited to console hardware.

The underlying game itself launched to massive commercial success, registering extraordinary figures including more than 39 million unique players on the PlayStation 5 alone according to platform reports.

A 15-year-old developer leading an unofficial computer adaptation project for Grand Theft Auto VI has clarified that the endeavor is still active following a brief departure caused by online friction and platform takedowns. The project, titled Leonida, aims to feature native Linux support and builds upon files previously circulated by community leakers while Rockstar Games remains silent on the matter.
